item.title: 1989 Porsche 944 Turbo
item.description: This 1989 Porsche 944 Turbo was initially delivered to Coast-Imported Car Corp, Tom River, New Jersey, and shows 72k miles. Powered by a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transaxle, the car is finished in Guards Red over black leather upholstery. Equipment includes 16" Club Sport alloy wheels, pop-up headlights, fog lights, power-adjustable front seats, a JVC head unit, and air conditioning.
